title: Reading lab: Acts 2:14–21
subtitle: Read proclamation and scriptural citation as connected discourse.
overview: Acts 2 moves from an address to an explanation and then a scriptural citation. Mark changes of speaker, quotation boundary, and future-oriented forms.
The goal is to follow Peter’s argument before attempting broader historical or theological conclusions.

items.grc: ἄνδρες Ἰουδαῖοι ... ἐνωτίσασθε τὰ ῥήματά μου.
items.en: Men of Judea ... give ear to my words.

items.grc: καὶ ἔσται πᾶς ὃς ἂν ἐπικαλέσηται τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου σωθήσεται.
items.en: And everyone who calls upon the name of the Lord will be saved.
